key_insight: Ink3D leverages large-scale video generative models to generate 3D assets with far more intricate and realistic textures than traditional 3D generative methods. The key idea is to transfer the texture modeling strength of video models into 3D asset synthesis.
problem_solved: Existing 3D generative models can create good geometry but often fail on complex surface textures because there is not enough high-quality 3D training data with rich appearance details.
method: Bridge 3D asset generation with pretrained video generative models that have learned complex visual patterns from massive datasets.
Use the video model as a strong prior for synthesizing detailed textures while preserving 3D structure.
Adapt the generation pipeline so the resulting asset is suitable for 3D use, not just 2D visual realism.
impact: This approach can help practitioners create more visually rich 3D assets with less reliance on scarce 3D texture datasets. It points to a practical path for improving 3D generation quality by reusing powerful foundation models trained on much larger video corpora.

paper_title: Ink3D: Sculpting 3D Assets with Extremely Complex Textures via Video Generative Models
paper_authors: Yue Han, Chong Li, Zhening Liu, Cong Huang, Fang Deng
